name: Cypress Point Club
architects: Alister MacKenzie with Robert Hunter, 1928 (Marion Hollins hired MacKenzie and shaped the 16th; Seth Raynor sketched a first routing in 1925); restoration work by Bill Coore and Ben Crenshaw since the 2010s (thefriedegg.com)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP elevation service (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, 1 m, float32), the world + 100 m in EPSG:26910 (NAD83 / UTM 10N), NAVD88 metres; downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release cypress-point-data, exportImage.17.tiff), rewritten with DEFLATE by make_dem.py. Sea hydro-flattened at 1.14 m.

ortho.source: USDA NAIP via the USGS USGSNAIPImagery ImageServer (exportImage, JPEG, 0.5 m, EPSG:32610), two halves downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (hahahs.jpg west, exportImage.jpg east), mosaicked by make_ortho.py; alignment against OSM greens and bunkers within 1-2 m

laz.source: 2018 FEMA Lidar: Region 9, CA (NOAA Data Access Viewer, job J1476067), flown 19 March - 9 April 2018 (GPS times); NAD83(2011) / California zone 4 (EPSG:6422, US survey feet) with NAVD88 heights in US survey feet; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; the project has only classes 1, 2, 9 and 10); ordered by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release cypress-point-data)
laz.label: 2018 FEMA Region 9 lidar

world.note: OSM course boundary w36435651 bbox (1,842 x 958 m, UTM 10N) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 2,048 m east-west (the limit; 103 m each side), 1,280 m north-south (161 m each side)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard as scanned by BlueGolf (undated, unverified; supplied by the developer in the release cypress-point-data, 2026-10-24, dde54a0db1e296e3bea71533_l.jpg). Men's ratings. Every tee row adds up to its printed total. No Blue tees: Middle (6,294 yd) is the set closest to 6,300 (COURSE_BUILD 4.1).
attribution: Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program; trees: FEMA Region 9 lidar (2018) via NOAA Digital Coast
Imagery for dune sand: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program
Scorecard: Cypress Point Club card (as scanned by BlueGolf)
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-24): Middle tees only (no Blue on the card; 6,294 yd is closest to 6,300); all water red, and the Pacific is a red penalty area everywhere, never out of bounds; OB = the OSM boundary w36435651, 17-Mile Drive and paths inside it are cart paths; open dune sand traced from NAIP and added as bunkers (sand=waste) until a waste-sand surface exists; new theme 'monterey'; wind open coast 3-14 mph.
